page.overview:
What is Alacria?

Alacria is a small plane of the Multiverse.

Alacria is a vast city composed of more than a dozen unique districts. Each district has a mascot called a "soul" that is embodied in a great beast with a soul-linked human counterpart. The plane has a rich sporting tradition.

Alacria is linked to Avishkar via a stable Omenpath.

Alacria was visited in the first Ghirapur Grand Prix and sent the Alacrian Quickbeasts to race in the second. The team is led by Caradora and her mount, Lagorin.
